questions.stem: What is the function of progesterone in the menstrual cycle?

options.text: It stimulates follicle development in the ovary
It maintains the thick uterus lining and inhibits FSH and LH
It causes the uterus lining to break down

questions.explanation: Progesterone is produced by the corpus luteum after ovulation. It maintains the thick uterus lining ready for a fertilised egg and inhibits FSH and LH to prevent further ovulation.
